name: Pool tick summary (why a pool project's queued rows do not spawn)

knobs.note: BH-7709: how many lines of logs/fly-pool.log bin/pool-tick-summary.sh reads with one tail per run, read as ${POOL_TICK_SUMMARY_TAIL_LINES:-20000}. A tick of 126 rows writes about 300-600 lines, so 20000 covers several ticks of every project. A value outside 1000..200000 is one ALERTS line and no read.

BH-7709: a project's newest tick counts as ended when its log has no line for this many seconds (or a stop line follows its header), read as ${POOL_TICK_SUMMARY_QUIET_S:-120}. Else the tick before it is reported, with in_progress_since. A value outside 30..1800 is one ALERTS line and no read.
Read by bin/pool-tick-summary.sh as ${POOL_TICK_SUMMARY_NOW:-<date +%s>}: the clock the hour counts and the quiet window are measured from. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
